import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    target = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()
    cdc = inputs["cdc_events"].copy()

    # Ensure proper dtypes
    target["device_id"] = target["device_id"].astype("int64")
    target["reading"] = target["reading"].astype("float64")
    target["applied_event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(target["applied_event_ts"])

    cdc["device_id"] = cdc["device_id"].astype("int64")
    cdc["reading"] = cdc["reading"].astype("float64")
    cdc["event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(cdc["event_ts"])
    cdc["event_seq"] = cdc["event_seq"].astype("int64")

    # Watermark lookup per device
    watermark = target[["device_id", "applied_event_ts"]].drop_duplicates(
        subset="device_id", keep="last"
    )

    # Merge cdc with watermark
    merged = cdc.merge(watermark, on="device_id", how="left", suffixes=("", "_wm"))

    # Determine eligibility: event_ts > applied_event_ts (watermark), or watermark is NaT (new device)
    wm_is_null = merged["applied_event_ts"].isna()
    eligible_mask = wm_is_null | (merged["event_ts"] > merged["applied_event_ts"])

    surviving = merged.loc[eligible_mask, ["device_id", "event_ts", "event_seq", "reading"]].copy()

    if not surviving.empty:
        # Sort to pick winner per device: latest by (event_ts, event_seq)
        surviving_sorted = surviving.sort_values(
            by=["device_id", "event_ts", "event_seq"],
            ascending=[True, True, True]
        )
        winners = surviving_sorted.groupby("device_id", as_index=False).tail(1)
    else:
        winners = surviving.copy()

    winners = winners.rename(columns={"event_ts": "applied_event_ts"})
    winners = winners[["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"]]

    updated_device_ids = set(winners["device_id"].tolist())

    # Devices in target not updated: carry forward
    carry_forward = target[~target["device_id"].isin(updated_device_ids)].copy()
    carry_forward = carry_forward[["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"]]

    result = pd.concat([winners, carry_forward], ignore_index=True)

    # Ensure dtypes
    result["device_id"] = result["device_id"].astype("int64")
    result["reading"] = result["reading"].astype("float64")
    result["applied_event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(result["applied_event_ts"])

    # Deduplicate by device_id just in case (shouldn't be needed, but ensure idempotency)
    result = result.drop_duplicates(subset="device_id", keep="first").reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"new_snapshot": result}
